guidance.description: True poverty is difficult or impossible to handle gracefully. But these articles suggest that a certain perspective shifts might help alleviate some anxiety.

commentaries.quote: People need all different kinds of stuff. We keep track of who has how much of each kind, and this bookkeeping causes all sorts of emotions: from admiration and inspiration to envy and anger.
We are all poor in something. It may help to know where your assets are unbalanced.
Poverty is not just a lack of money, it is not having the capability to realize one's full potential as a human being.
We think sometimes that poverty is only being hungry, naked and homeless. The poverty of being unwanted, unloved and uncared for is the greatest poverty.
Do you think, because I am poor, obscure, plain and little, I am soulless and heartless? You think wrong!
